description: The financial and legal mechanics of the art market: advisor conflicts of interest, provenance and authentication risk, primary versus secondary market signals, 2023-2025 Artprice100 index performance, and older academic return studies (Mei & Moses; Renneboog & Spaenjers), presented as historical context. The two studies reach different conclusions.
name: art.deep_dive_track
title: Art Market Deep Dive Track
